notes.title: Dangerous Cnidaria 4.3
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We're super excited to share with you the work we've been doing on:
- The terrain, now with weather effects (and affections)
- The cnidaria (a second species coming soon), a dangerous predator with excellent defense systems
- The porifera, an animal we know so little about (usually), very resistant to radiation (and cancer), that will be breaking it's parts in your ocean now (and making everything pretty of course)
- Sophie's voice - our beloved AI will not go on voiceless and now (little by little) we're recording our very own Rachel Morin (awesome molecular biologist) who became Sophie recently. 
- AI with reproduction, hunting, fleeing, breaking, just hanging out and searching for resources.
- Oh... clouds. They are pretty.
- Techtowers mean pollution, but they charge Emmanuel's awesome tools to use outside.
- Check out our Evolution Tree clicking on the Opabinia Egg with everything we have prepared for you in the future!

- Let us know what you think and join our Discord to stream your gameplay!

https://discord.gg/FFeyhrGaTv

notes.title: Out of the Water
notes.content:
In this Update we will open the world outside for you. Fly around with Emmanuel BT9 to explore it and use the genes you fought for in the cell stage to create fungi (we'll start with basidiomycota and ascomycota), plantae (phytoplankton, magnoliophyta and bryophyta) and animalia (Opabinia Regalis, more coming soon!).

In this update:

- Go outside and use the genes you made to create fungi, plantae and animalia
- Experience the weather and temperature variations and see how they affect the life you created
- Go underwater, but be careful - Emmanuel's shields can only take so much pressure don't overdo it
- Experience a day/night cycle and a dynamic Sun that interacts with the life you created
- Watch as plants, fungi and animals reproduce and try to study a better way for them to do it
- Create Techtowers (that cause pollution) to gain access to Emmanuel's special tools like lasers and boost
- A lot of improvents and new animations on the cell stage

notes.title: Engineered E.Coli 5.9
notes.content:
ENGINEERED E.COLI 5.9

Hello everyone! Before anything else, I want to thank everyone that has been playing and helping us build the first game by Fire Game Studios. You're all breathtaking! We've been working around the clock to balance our biosystem and try to make everything difficult, but fair. We also have some great news about those brave enough to reach level 4 - Genetic Engineering! Now, you'll be able to spend your hard earned money on genetically engineered cells and choose dominant and recessive genes. You even get a mutation for free (for better or worse, as always).

- Genetic engineering system on Level 4
- A flare representing areas with sunlight so you can place your cyanobacteria in the right spots
- New tooltip system with information about the GE (genetic engineering) and the cell's full genome
- Objectives are fully randomized now, with random amounts you need to complete
- A bar showing how much of your objective has been added, as requested by our player base
- Tooltip that shows info about the mutations you bought were added

Changes:
- Mitosis now properly creates two protocells with same atp the original cell had

Bugs:
- Fixed issue with mitochondria not breathing in some cases
- Fixed issue with spawning too many oxygen clouds and FPS drop
- Fixed issue with pressure tool not working properly, it's actually a very useful tool now

For the future:
- We will add another gene you can buy at the GE Panel to increase the fertility of your cells, so they will reproduce at a faster pace.

notes.title: Update Sassy Mitochondrion 1.0
notes.content:
Thank you for all that started playing Biosys Inc! All the feeback is giving us a lot to work on and we love it! We checked all the bugs related by players and here's what we fixed in this small update (Sassy Mitochondrion 1.0):

FIXED

1) An issue with mitochondria and chloroplasts not breathing oxygen or producing ATP during photosynthesis.
2) Some missions not giving money in level 1.

NEW STUFF
1) New icon to represent the random mutation that WILL happen if you press a number that doesn't have a RNA strand in it

These things are not in this update, but we're working on them:
1) Some O2 fields are disappearing when you load the game.
2) Sometimes the game pauses and you can't unpause it.
